newsitem.title: KENYA: Special boards lift up Nairobi bourse shares.
newsitem.headline: Special boards lift up Nairobi bourse shares.

text.p: Heavy trading on the special boards at the Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) boosted several key shares, bourse officials said.
The NSE 20-share index edged up 19.87 points to close at 3417.11. Turnover was posted at 32.9 million shillings from 747,083 shares from 13.1 million shillings on 353,665 shares on Thursday.
Nation Printers & Publishers closed at 118 from 109 while Lonrho Motors edged up a shilling to close at 50.
On the three-day special board, Kenya Airways traded at a reserve price of 8.50 from 8.10 while Rea Vipingo traded at 9 unchanged. Kenya Power & Lighting also traded at 170 unchanged.
"The market is very mixed right now. Some shares have picked up largely on foreign demand," one broker said.
Another broker added that perhaps with the budget, the quiet market would receive a new lease of life.
The budget is scheduled for June 19.
Foreign investors bought Kenya Commercial Bank at between 102 and 103, Firestone East Africa at between 27.50-30 from 28.25.
The Central Bank of Kenya floating-rate treasury bond traded at 104.7588 percent from 104.7440 percent.
